html:
Dear Your Family,

A kolam at your doorstep

Every morning begins with a kolam at the doorstep

Colour for joy, flowers for welcome

and a lamp for a new beginning

Siddharth & Kayal

29 · 08 · 2027 · MAHABALIPURAM

At the doorstep of a new life

Siddharth & Kayal

ARE GETTING MARRIED · AT SUNRISE

SCROLL FOR THE SUNRISE

Best with sound on

With the blessings of our elders

Mr. A. Natarajan & Mrs. N. Revathi

request the pleasure of your company at the wedding of their son

Siddharth

with

Kayal

daughter of Mr. M. Selvam & Mrs. S. Jothi

Saturday 28 & Sunday 29 August 2027
by the sea, Mahabalipuram

Saptapadi

Seven steps, seven promises

On the wedding day they take seven steps together, one promise with every step. Walk with them.

Colour for joy, flowers for welcome
and a lamp for a new beginning
At the doorstep of a new life
With the blessings of our elders
Mr. A. Natarajan & Mrs. N. Revathi
request the pleasure of your company at the wedding of their son
daughter of Mr. M. Selvam & Mrs. S. Jothi
Saturday 28 & Sunday 29 August 2027by the sea, Mahabalipuram
On the wedding day they take seven steps together, one promise with every step. Walk with them.
With the first step, we promise to nourish each other.
With the second, to grow strong together, in body and mind.
With the third, to build our home with honesty and hard work.
With the fourth, to share every joy and every sorrow.
With the fifth, to cherish our families, old and new.
With the sixth, to walk together through every season.
With the seventh, to be friends, for life.
Seven steps, and two become one.
Breakfast follows · Dress: ivory and cream
The Muhurtham begins at sunrise. Please be seated by 5:45 AM.
Soft pastels for the Reception, ivory and cream for the Muhurtham.
Rooms are held at Shoreline for family and friends. Just ask.
Your presence and your blessings are all we wish for.

This is a CINOREV demo, so replies come to us. In your own invitation, they come straight to your family.

images.alt: Siddharth in an ivory kurta and veshti and Kayal in an ivory silk saree with jasmine in her braid, smiling against a terracotta wall
The bride's feet with silver anklets and red-painted edges beside the groom's bare feet, stepping onto a small white kolam
Siddharth and Kayal in jasmine garlands under a banana-trunk mandapam on the beach at sunrise, an old stone shore temple far away
Siddharth and Kayal seen from behind, sitting close on a seaside terrace under a sky full of stars, clay lamps and a white kolam beside them
